name: NeRF-W
aliases: Neural Radiance Fields for Unconstrained Photo Collections
definition: NeRF-W is an extension of NeRF that relaxes strict consistency assumptions to handle in-the-wild photo collections. It models per-image appearance variations in a learned low-dimensional latent space and decomposes scene content into 'static' and 'transient' components using a secondary volumetric radiance field combined with a data-dependent uncertainty field.
